preamble: Palatalization of the aspirated velar [kʰ] to the aspirated alveolo-palatal affricate [tɕʰ] before front vowels or a palatal glide. In Mandarin, Middle Chinese kʰ- before high front vowels and glides became the q- series (去 khjoH > qù); Shanghainese Wu shows the same development (去 [tɕʰi]). In Burmese the Written Burmese onset khy- [kʰj] coalesced into [tɕʰ] (ချစ် khyac 'love' /tɕʰɪʔ/), merging with reflexes of khl- and khr-.

examples.note: Wu palatalized velars independently of Mandarin; Cantonese heoi3 and Hakka hi instead show kʰ > h.
The medial -y- fused with the aspirated velar into an alveolo-palatal affricate.
